brief.goal: Add a minimal Case-aware workbench progress refresh control and make the local service load it.

allowed_writes: Task, Context Manifest, control-plane and design documentation
workbench frontend, presentation-only status mapping and tests
forbidden_actions: all external platform calls, writes and runtime workflow commands
all confirmation consumption, resource preparation and std_project/create
database schema or workflow_case_summary View changes
browser persistence or sensitive/raw platform data
validation_plan: LaunchAgent health and browser visual check
stop_conditions: a change requires a new API, database migration or background worker
a refresh path could write to the platform or create a runtime Job
the rendered view would expose token, secret, full URL or raw platform data
